sa: द्रौपदी च सभामध्ये पाञ्चाली धर्मचारिणी। पर्याकृष्टानवद्याङ्गी पत्नी नो गुरुसंनिधौ॥
en: It was for him that the virtuous princess of Panchala, Draupadi of faultless features, our wife, was dragged into the midst of the countries before all our elders.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा पततस्तूर्णमभिक्रुद्धाञ्जनार्दनः। न चुक्रोध महातेजा जानन् कालस्य पर्ययम्॥
en: Janardana of great energy, knowing the character of the hour stood unmoved without giving way to anger, seeing those heroes rushing in anger at Satyaki from every side.

sa: स कदाचिद्याज्यकार्येणाभिप्रस्थित उत्तङ्कनामानं शिष्यं नियोजयामास॥ 'भो यत् किंचिदस्मद्गृहे परिहीयते, तदिच्छाम्यहमपरिहीयमानं भवता क्रियमाणम्' इति। स एवं प्रतिसंदिश्योत्तवं वेदः प्रवासं जगाम॥
en: One day when he was going to depart on a sacrificial business, he employed one of his pupils, named Uttanka, to look after nis house and family. He said, “Uttanka, whatever should be required to be done in my house, let it be done by you without neglect." Having given him these instructions, Veda went away on his journey.

sa: स तु वृक्षण निर्भग्नः सालताडनविह्वलः। गुरुभारभराक्रान्ता नौः ससार्थेव सागरे॥
en: Being thus smitten by the tree and overwhelmed with the strike of Sāla he was troubled like to a heavily laden boat in the midst of an ocean.

sa: आचाराद् वर्धते ह्यायुराचारो हन्त्यलक्षणम्॥ आगमानां हि सर्वेषामाचारः श्रेष्ठ उच्यते।
en: It is conduct which prolongs life. It is conduct which destroys all calamitics and evils. Conduct has been said to be superior 10 all the branches of knowledge.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रात्मजाः सर्वे यातुधाना बलोत्कटाः॥ ऋद्धिमन्तो महात्मानः शस्त्रपूता दिवं गताः।
en: The of Dhritarashtra were all Rakshasas of great power. Sanctified by death caused by weapons, those great beings of great prosperity all succeeded in acquiring the celestial region.

sa: तथान्ये व. रश्रेष्ठा विन्ध्यपर्वतवासिनः। न शक्यन्ते बहुत्वात्तु संख्यातुं लघुविक्रमाः॥
en: (Besides these), there are other choice monkeys dwelling in the Vindhya mountain, but I cannot enumerate these (monkeys) possessed of fleet vigour, in consequence of their vast number.

sa: ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्। गणयित्वा यथोक्तानि तावन्त्येव फलानि तु॥
en: Then again he numbered all the fruits; and found out the truth of what the king had said; and, thus struck with astonishment, he addressed the monarch, saying,

sa: ततस्तथ सरस्वत्याः पावनं लोकविश्रुतम्। तस्मिंश्च यदुशार्दूलो दत्त्वा तीर्थे पयस्विनीः॥ ताम्रायसानि भाण्डानि वस्त्राणि विविधानि च। पूजयित्वा द्विजांश्चैव पूजितश्च तपोधनैः॥
en: That tree is the cause of this tirtha. Having given away many milch cows, vessels of copper and iron and diverse sorts of other vessels, that foremost Yadu's race, viz., Baladeva, having the plough for his weapon, worshipped the Brahmanas and was adored by them in return. He then, O king, went to the Dvaita lake.

sa: यदि चायमभिप्रायस्तव ज्ञातीन् व्रजेदिति। सहितावेव गच्छावो विदर्भान् यदि मन्यसे॥
en: If it be your wish that I should go back to my kinsmen, then if it list you, we both together shall repair to the kingdom of Vidharbha.

sa: तेन पषिगणाः प्रीता भवन्ति मधुसूदन। नित्यमग्निं परिचरेदभुक्त्वा बलिकर्म च॥
en: By such acts, O destroyer of Madhu Rishis also are pleased. The householders, abstaining from food, should daily attend to his sacred fire and to his sacrificial offerings.

sa: त्रिधाभूतैरवध्यन्त पाण्डवैः कौरवा युधि। तथैव कौरवै राजन्नवध्यन्त परे रणे॥
en: Thus were the Kauravas slain in battle by the Pandavas divided in two divisions, so also, O monarch, the Pandavas were slaughtered by the Kauravas in that fight.

sa: ब्राह्मणो वाप्यसवृत्तः सर्वसंकरभोजनः। ब्राह्मण्यं स समुत्सृज्य शूद्रो भवति तादृशः॥
en: One who is a Brahmana, when he becomes wicked in conduct and observes no distinction about food, falls away from the status of Brahmanahood and becomes a Shudra.

sa: स्पृशंश्चैव प्रतिष्ठेत च चाप्याट्टैण पाणिना॥ अङ्गुष्ठस्यान्तराले च ब्राह्यं तीर्थमुदाहृतम्।
en: One should not, however, keep his hands wet. Between the tip and the root of the thumb is situate the sacred Tirtha known by the name of Brahma.

sa: उत्तिष्ठ पुत्र पश्येमां दुःखिता प्रपितामहीम्। आर्तामुपप्लुतां दीनां निमग्नां शोकसागरे॥
en: Rise, O son, and see this your afflicted great grandmother! She is deeply stricken with grief, bathed in tears, exceedingly cheerless, and plunged in an ocean of sorrow.

sa: एतस्य रथसिंहस्य तवार्थं राजसत्तम। पराक्रमं यथेन्द्रस्य द्रक्ष्यन्ति कुरवो युधि॥
en: The prowess of this best among car warriors excited on your behalf, O best among kings, the Kurus in battle with see equal to that of Indra himself.

sa: प्रयुध्यतोरथ तयोर्बाणवषैः समन्ततः। नाज्ञायत तदा किंचित्सर्वं हि तमसा वृतम्॥
en: They having been thus engaged with each other with the downpour of dreadful shafts, all the quarters were filled with darkness and in consequence thereof nothing was visible.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा विबुधा वाक्यं विस्मिता यत्नमास्थिताः। परिवार्यामृतं तस्थुर्वज्री चेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: The celestials, when they heard it, were astonished and they took precautions. They stood surrounding the Ambrosia and the greatly powerful Indra stood with them, thunder-bolt in hand.

sa: दिशं प्राची समाश्रित्य हृष्टानां गच्छतां भृशम्। रथनेमिस्वनाश्चैव श्रूयन्ते लोमहर्षणाः॥
en: That defending noise made by the rejoicing warriors as they are going to their quarters, as also the clatter of their car-wheels, comes to us from the east.

sa: कश्च रामः कथंवीर्यः किंरूपः किंपराक्रमः। किमर्थे दण्डकारण्यं प्रविष्टश्च सुदुस्तरम्॥
en: Who is Rāma? And what is his prowess? And what his form? And what his power? And why had he entered the forest of Dandaka, difficult to range?

sa: न च राजा तथाकार्षीत् कालपर्यायधर्मवित्। ततोऽनुमान्य धर्मात्मा पौरजानपदं जनम्॥
en: The king, knowing the changes brought about by time, did not listen to their advice. were Possessed of righteous soul, he persuaded the people to submit his views.

sa: यः कश्चिन्निरयात् तस्मात् समुत्तरति कर्हिचित्। मानुष्यं लभते चापि हीनायुस्तत्र जायते॥ पापेन कर्मणा देवि बद्धो हिंसारतिर्नरः। अप्रियः सर्वभूतानां हीनायुरुपजायते॥ यस्तु शुक्लाभिजातीयः प्राणिघातविवर्जकः। निक्षिप्तशस्त्रो निर्दण्डो न हिंसति कदाचन॥ न घातयति ना हन्ति नंन्त नैवानुमोदते। सर्वभूतेषु सस्नेहो यथाऽऽत्मनि तथापरे॥ ईदृशः पुरुषोत्कर्षो देवि देवत्वमश्नुते। उपपन्नान् सुखान् भोगानुपाश्नाति मुदा युतः॥
en: That man who is given to slaughter and injury, O goddess, becomes, through his sinful deeds, liable to destruction. Such a person becomes disagreeable to all creatures and shortlived. That man who belongs to what is called the White class, who abstains from the destruction of living crcatures, who has thrown away all weapons, and never inflicts any punishment on any body, who never injures any creature, who never causes anybody to kill creatures for him, who never kills or strikes even when struck or attempted to be killed, who never sanctions or approves an act of destruction, who is gifted with mercy towards all creatures who treats others as his own self, such a superior man, O goddess, succeeds in acquiring to the dignity of a celestial. Filled with joy, such a man enjoys various kinds

sa: परो धर्मः कृतो मह्यं शिष्योऽस्मि भवतोस्तथा। इमान्यासनमुख्यानि आस्यतां मुनिपुङ्गवौ॥
en: I have reaped high religious merit (by these nuptials), and I also am your disciple. And do you, you anchorets, occupy these best of thrones, (belonging to us).15

sa: तच्छिरंः प्रापतद् भूमौ श्येनाहतमिवामिषम्। ततोऽस्य कायो वसुधां पश्चात् प्रापतदच्युत॥
en: His head fell down on the earth like a piece of meant stolen away by a hawk, afterwards his body, O Eternal one, fell down on the earth.

sa: धनुषस्तस्य वीर्यं हि जिज्ञासन्तो महीक्षितः। न शेकुरारोपयितुं राजपुत्रा महाबलाः॥
en: And desirous of being acquainted with the prowess of this bow, many kings and princes came; but they in spite of their mighty strength, failed in stringing it.

sa: व्यास उवाच नान्यत्र विद्यातपसोर्नान्यत्रेन्द्रियनिग्रहात्। नान्यत्र सर्वसंत्यागात् सिद्धिं विन्दति कश्चन॥
en: Vyasa said No man achieves success by any other means save the acquisition of knowledge, the practice of penances, the control of the senses, and renunciation of everything.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मणः स्थानमुत्तमम्। ब्रह्मोदुम्बरमित्येव प्रकाशं भुवि भारत॥
en: O king of kings, O descendant of Bharata, one should then go to that excellent region of Brahma which is celebrated on earth by the name of Brahmodumbara.

sa: कष्टं हीदं व्यवसितं पाण्डवेन महात्मना। पुत्रशोकाभितप्तेन प्रतिज्ञा महती कृता॥
en: "The vow which the high-souled son of Pandu has made, is a very difficult one. King Jayadratha is endued with great energy. may Arjuna successfully observe his vow!

sa: धर्मार्थयुक्तं वचनमाह त्वां तात केशवः। तथा भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तज्जुषस्व नराधिप॥
en: “Keshava said words to you which are pregnant with virtue and profit, my dear son,; so did Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, O ruler of men, accept them.

sa: सुमन्त्रितं सुनीतं च न्यायतश्चोपपादितम्। कृतं मानुष्यकं कर्भ दैवेनापि विस्थ्यते॥
en: The acts performed by a man well advised, well controlled and done in a way not injurious to any body has contrary effect by the dispensations of Providence.

sa: तावकानां तु सैन्यानां प्रहर्षः समजायत। वादित्रनिनदश्चोग्रः सुमहान् रोमहर्षणः ३७॥
en: The soldiers of your army were then filled with delight; the musical instruments were then struck up emitting fierce and deep sound, making the hair to stand erect.

sa: नापत्रपन्त पापानि कुर्वन्तो वृष्णयस्तदा। प्राद्विषन् ब्राह्मणांश्चापि पितृन् देवांस्तथैव च॥
en: The Vrishnis, committing sinful deeds, were not seen to feel any shame. They showed disregard for Brahmanas and the departed manes and the departed manes and the celestials.

sa: अहं विनिकृतो राम चरामीह भयादितः॥ हृतभार्यो वने त्रस्तो दुर्गमेतदुपाश्रितः।
en: Oppressed have I been, O Rama; and here am always afflicted with fear. Deprived of my wife, I have, agitated with apprehension, sought refuge in this dense wilderness.

sa: तेषु प्रकाल्यमानेषु दस्यून् दुःशासनोऽब्ररीत्। निवर्तध्वमधर्मज्ञा युध्यध्वं किं सृतेन वः॥
en: 'Ye heroes, ignorant of the rules of fighting, fight on.” Why do you retreat? But seeing them break away in spite of all his commands yo!'r son Dushasana.

sa: ततो मूलफलप्रायं पायसं मधुसर्पिघा। आस्तीके भोजयेद् राजन् दद्याच्चैव गुडौदनम्॥
en: When the Astika Parva is being recited, Brahmanas should be entertained with fruits and roots, and frumenty, and hosey and clarified butter, and rice boiled with raw sugar.

sa: बुभुक्षापनयं दत्त्वा चन्द्राकौं मम वासव। किमिदं तत्त्वया दत्तमन्यस्य बलवृत्रहन्॥
en: O Vasava! O slayer of Bala and Vrtra-to remove my hunger you did give me both the sun and moon; why you have then given them to another?

sa: रोममेव हि पश्यामि रहिते राक्षसेश्वर। दृष्ट्वा स्वप्नगतं राममुद्धमामीव चेतनः॥
en: O king of Räksasas, I see Rāma even in the quarter where there is no Rāma. Seeing him in my dreams even I look around like one awaken.

sa: गान्धार्युवाच पाण्डवा धार्तराष्ट्राश्च दग्धाः कृष्ण परस्परम्। उपेक्षिता विनश्यन्तस्त्वया कस्माज्जनार्दन॥
en: Gandhari said The Pandavas and the Dhartarashtra, O Krishna, have both been consumed. Whilst they were thus being rotted out, O Janarddana, why were you indifferent to them.

sa: यस्य प्रभावाच्च गयस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः। वटचाक्षय्यकरणः पुण्यं ब्रह्मसरश्च तत्॥
en: Through that great sacrifice of his, Gaya became well-known in the three worlds; and the eternal Banian tree and the holy Brahmalake, owe their origin to that sacrifice.

sa: तां भक्त्वा स महाशाखां स्मयमानो विलोकयन्। अथात्र लम्बतोऽपश्यद्वालखिल्यानधोमुखान्॥ ॥
en: As he cast his eyes in wonder on the broken branch of the tree, he saw that the Valakhilya Rishis were hanging form it, with their heads downwards.

sa: ततो विषविमुक्तात्मा स्वं रूपमकरोत् कलिः। तं शप्तुमैच्छत् कुपितो निषधाधिपतिर्नलः॥
en: Thereupon Kali, with his soul freed from the poison, assumed his own form. Then Nala, the prince of the Nishadhas, became angry and was intent upon cursing him.

sa: इदं च तदनुप्राप्तमब्रवीद् यद् युधिष्ठिरः। पुरा व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु दृष्ट्वोत्पातान् सुदारुणान्॥
en: The present is exactly similar to that time which Yudhishthira had marked at sight of those dreadful omens which appeared when the two armies were arranged in battle-order.

sa: ततः सीतवनं गच्छेन्नियतो नियताशनः। तीर्थं तत्र महाराज महदन्यत्र दुर्लभम्॥
en: O great king, one should then go with regulated diet and subdued soul to Sitavana. There is one thing there which is not to be seen anywhere else.

sa: निर्गच्छतस्तु शक्रस्य परुषः पवनो ववौ। भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चैव महोल्काश्च प्रपेदिरे॥
en: He, having set out for battle, the winds began to blow high, the sun was divested of its brilliance and the huge fire-brands began to send out flames.

sa: तं गुणैः समतां प्राप्तो भ्राता विपुलविक्रमः। सौमित्रिरनुवव्राज धारयन् दुःखमात्मजम्॥
en: Then followed him, the son of Sumitrā, of mighty prowess, of equal accomplishments with his brother, and bearing the mental sorrow. Rāma, entering the abode of his mother.

sa: सोऽग्रानीकस्य महत इषुपाते धनंजयः। व्यवस्थाप्य रथं राजशङ्ख दध्मौ प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then Dhananjaya endued with great might, O king, stopping his chariot before the van of his troops where the thickest downpour of arrows was expected blew his conch.

sa: एवं मे चरतस्तत्र सर्वयत्नेन शत्रुहन्। प्रीतिमानभवद् वीरो मातलिः शक्रसारथिः॥
en: O destroyer of foes, the heroic charioteer of Shakra, Matali, seeing me thus course there (on the field of battle) exerting my utmost, became well pleased (with me).

sa: अश्वत्थाम्नि कृपे चैव तथैव कृतवर्मणि। तथेतरेषु क्रुद्धेषु तावकानामपि क्षयः॥
en: As also when Ashvathama, and Kripa and Kritavarma (were wrought up with rage). So also your troops under went destruction when the other side was inflamed with wrath.

sa: स तान्प्रवृद्धान् विनिहत्य राक्षसान् महाबलश्चण्डपराक्रमः कपिः। स्तदेव वीरोऽभिजगाम तोरणम्॥
en: Having slain those overgrown Rākşasas, that exceedingly powerful and heroic monkey of terrific power, desirous of again coping with other Rākşasas, retraced his steps to the selfsame entrance.

sa: तत् सर्वमनवाप्येयं श्रमशोकाध्वकर्शिता। शेते निपतिता भूमौ पापस्य मम कर्मभिः॥
en: Afflicted with hardship, sorrow and travel, it is on account of my wretched act, she (now) lies prostrate on the ground without having obtained any thing hoped for.

sa: तथैवं वदतस्तस्य भारद्वाजस्य सारथेः। प्रत्यदृश्यत शैनेयो निघ्नन् बहुविधान् रथान्॥
en: The grandson of Sini suddenly came to view, engaged in siaughtering a large number of car-warriors. Those soldiers of yours while being thus slaughtered by Yuyudhana in battle.

sa: तैः स्वयं रचितो मार्गो दुर्गमो हि पुनर्भवेत्। सम्पतद्भिर्महावेगैर्यास्यद्भिरिह सद्गतिम्॥
en: They have gone there. The road will once more become difficult on account of a number of heroes that will hurry along it for reaching that happy region.

sa: अथ सर्वे पुरा शरणमर्दिताः॥ ते तमूचुर्महात्मानं सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः।
en: Thereupon all the celestials, afflicted as they were, sought the refuge of Rudra. The gods then, with Vasava at their head, said these words to that high-souled one.

sa: भरतस्यान्वये चैवाजमीढो नाम पार्थिवः। बभूव भरतश्रेष्ठ यज्वा धर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: There was O foremost of Bharata's descendants, in the family of Bharata, a king named Ajamida, who celebrated many sacrifices and was the best of all virtuous men.

sa: न चात्मा शक्यते द्रष्टुमिन्द्रियैश्च विभागशः। तत्र तत्र विसृष्टैश्च दुर्वायैश्चाकृतात्मभिः॥
en: He who knows this, is really wise. What other mark is there of a wise man? Acquiring this knowledge, intelligent men considered themselves to be crowned with success.

sa: सुरासुरगणानां च देवर्षीणां च भाविनि। ननु नागा महावीर्याः सौरसेयास्तरस्विनः॥
en: Amongst the gods and Asuras and celestial Rishis, O amiable lady, the Nagas are endued with great energy. Having great speed, they are endued again with excellent fragrance.

sa: वेदानधीत्य नियतो दक्षिणामपवर्त्य च। अभ्यनुज्ञामथ प्राप्य समावर्तेत वै द्विजः॥
en: Having read the Vedas with close attention, and controlled his senses, and having given his preceptor the tuition-fee, he should, with the order of his preceptor, return home.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततश्चितां बकपते: कारयामास राक्षसः। रत्नैर्गन्धैश्च बहुभिर्वस्त्रैश्च समलंकृताम्॥
en: Bhishma Said The Rakshasa king then caused a funeral pyre to be made for that king of cranes and decked it with jewels, gems, perfumes, and, costly dresses.

sa: तस्यानुकम्पया देवी प्रीता समभवत् तदा। वेदमाता ततस्तस्य तज्जप्यं समपूजयत्॥
en: The goddess felt mercy for him and became highly pleased. Then the mother of the Vedas spoke highly of that recitation in which the Brahmana had been engaged.

sa: इन्द्रियैः सह सुप्तस्य देहिनः शत्रुतापन। सूक्ष्मश्चरति सर्वत्र नभसीव समीरणः॥
en: When the embodied creature, O scorcher of enemies, goes into sleep together with his senses, the subtile Soul then roves among all objects like the wind through ether.

sa: गृहीत एव तु तया देवेन्द्रो भरतर्षभ।॥ पितामहमुपागम्य शिरसा प्रत्यपूजयत्।
en: Seized by her, O foremost of Bharata's race, the king of the gods at last presented himself before the Grandfather and adored him by bending low his head.

sa: वेदवादाश्चानुयुगं ह्रसन्तीतीह नः श्रुतम्। आयूंषि चाशिषश्चैव वेदस्यैव च यत्फलम्॥
en: We have heard that, in the succeeding Yugas, the words of the Vedas, the periods of life, the blessings and the fruits of Vedic rites, all decrease gradually.

sa: सप्ताङ्गश्चैव संघातस्त्रयश्चान्ये नृपोत्तम। सम्भूय दशवर्गोऽयं भुङ्क्ते राज्यं हि राजवत्॥
en: The seven limbs already mentioned, O best of kings, and the three others, forming ten, supporting one another, are said to enjoy the kingdom like the king himself.

sa: स कदाचिन्महातेजा जलवासो महीपते। चचार लोकान् विप्रर्षिः प्रेक्षमाणो मनोजवः॥
en: Highly energetic that regenerate ascetic, O king, while living within the waters, travelled through all the worlds with the speed of the mind, desirous of seeing all things.

sa: होतारो वृषलानां च वृषलाध्यापकास्तथा। तथा वृषलशिष्याश्च राजन् नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: Those Brahmanas who pour libations on the sacred fire for Shudras or who are preceptors of Shudras, or who are servant of Shudra masters, should not be invited.

sa: ततो विमुच्य देवेन्द्रं ब्रह्मवध्या युधिष्ठिर। यथा विसृष्टं तं वासमगमद्देवशासनात्॥
en: Bhishma said Then, leaving the king of the deities, the sin of Brahmanicide, O Yudhishthira, proceeded to the abodes that were settled for her at the Grandfather's behest.

sa: उपभोगैरपि त्यक्तं नात्मानं सादयेन्नरः। चण्डालत्वेऽपि मानुष्यं सर्वथा तात शोभनम्॥
en: One should never emaciate himself by abstaining from every enjoyment. Of all births, that of a human being is preferable even if one has to become a Chandala.

sa: प्रहर्षः प्रीतिरानन्दः सुखं संशान्तचित्तता। अकुतश्चित् कुतश्चिद्वा चिन्तितः सात्त्विको गुणः॥
en: Pleasure, satisfaction, joy, happiness, and tranquillity, originating in the mind from any perceptible cause or in the absence of any apparent cause, appertain to the quality of Goodness.

sa: तया जगदिदं कृत्स्नमटन्त्या मिथिलेश्वरः। तत्र तत्र श्रुतो मोक्षे कथ्यमानस्त्रिदण्डिभिः॥
en: In course of her wanderings over the Earth, Sulabha heard from many ascetics of different places that the king of Mithila was given to the religion of Liberation.

sa: भीष्म उवाच जनको जनदेवस्तु ज्ञापितः परमर्षिणा। पुनरेवानुपप्रच्छ साम्पराये भवाभुवौ॥
en: Bhishma said "Thus instructed by the great Rishi Panchashikha, Janadeva of the family of Janaka, once more asked him about the subject of existence or non-existence after death.

sa: एतावतापि लाभेन तोष्टुमर्हसि काश्यप। किं पुनर्योऽसि सत्त्वानां सर्वेषां ब्राह्मणोत्तमः॥
en: With this gain, you should O Kashyapa, be contented. How happy, again, should you feel yourself, as you think that amongst living creatures you are a superior Brahmana.

sa: कुतः क्षीरोदनं वत्स मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्॥ वने निवसतां नित्यं कन्दमूलफलाशिनाम्।
en: Whence, O child, can ascetics of purified souls get food prepared with milk? Such men always live in the forest and live upon bulbs and roots and fruits.

sa: यत्राविशन्ति कल्पान्ते सर्वे ब्रह्मादय: सुराः॥ ऋषयश्च सगन्धर्वा यच्च किंचिच्चराचरम्।
en: At the end of the aeon, all the gods having Brahman for their foremost, all Rishis with the Gandharvas, and all things mobile and immobile, enter into Narayana.

sa: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ वायुभूमिरापोऽग्निरेव च। सर्वे च नक्षत्रगणा यच्च भूताभिशब्दितम्॥ अधिकारेषु वर्तन्ते यथास्वं ब्रह्मवादिनः। सर्वे प्रमाणं हि यथा तथा तच्छास्त्रमुत्तमम्॥ भविष्यति प्रमाणं वै एतन्मदनुशासनम्। तस्मात् प्रवक्ष्यते धर्मान् मनुः स्वायम्भुवः स्वयम्॥
en: The Sun, and the Moon, Wind, and Earth, and Water and Fire, all the stars and planets and constellations, all else that is called by the name of creatures, and utterers of Brahma, all live and act in their respective spheres and are all respected as authorities. This work which you have composed shall be regarded by all persons, as a work of the highest authority. This is my order. Guided by this treatise, the Self-created Manu himself will declare to the world its duties and observances.

sa: धर्म सतां हितः पुंसां धर्मश्चैवाश्रयः सताम्। धर्माल्लोकास्त्रयस्तात प्रवृत्ता: सचराचराः॥
en: Virtue is beneficial to them that are good. Virtue is the refuge of the good. From virtue have originated the three worlds with their mobile and immobile creatures.

sa: देवतानां समावायमेकस्थं पितरं विदुः। मानां देवातनां च स्नेहादभ्येति मातरम्॥
en: The father must be known to be a combination of all the gods together. The mother, however, is a combination of all mortal creatures and all the gods.

sa: अण्डजे जन्मनि पुनर्ब्रह्मणे हरियोनये। एष धर्मः समुद्भूतो नारायणमुखात् पुनः॥
en: In the next birth of Brahman, viz., that which he derived from an egg which originated from Hari, this religion once more issued from the mouth of Narayana.

sa: अथ द्वादशके तस्मिन् सत्त्वं नामापरो गुणः। महासत्त्वोऽल्पसत्त्वो वा जन्तुर्येनानुमीयते॥
en: After the twelfth, Sattva is another principle numbering the thirteenth. With its aid creatures are distinguished as possess more of it or less of it in their constitutions,

sa: यथोचितं च स बको ययौ ब्रह्मसदस्तथा॥ ब्रह्मा चैनं महात्मानमातिथ्येनाभ्यपूजयत्।
en: At the due hour he went (the next day) to the Grandfather's region. The latter honoured the great bird with such attentions as are shown to a guest.

sa: न दिशाऽविन्दत नृपः क्षुत्पिपासादितस्तदा। इतश्चेतश्च वै राजन् श्रमतृष्णान्वितो नृप॥
en: Stricken with hunger and thirst, the king's confusion was so great that he could not see the cardinal points. Indeed, stricken with thirst, he began to rove about.

sa: विरुद्धानीह शास्त्राणि ये पश्यन्ति कुरूद्वह। विधित्सा जायते तेषां तत्त्वज्ञानान्निवर्तते॥
en: Men, O you of Kuru's race find divergent scriptures. Therefrom originates the desire for various kinds of action. When true knowledge has been acquired, that desire is satisfied.

sa: प्रज्ञया मानसं दुःखं हन्याच्छारीरमौषधैः। एतद् विज्ञानसामर्थ्यं न बालैः समतामियात्॥
en: One should remove mental sorrow by wisdom, and physical sorrow should be cured by medicines. Wisdom teaches this. One should not, while under sorrow, act like a child.

sa: पापात् पापसमाचारनिहीनाच्च नराधिप। पाप एव वधः प्रोक्तो नरकायेति निश्चयः॥
en: Death at the hands of one who is sinful, or of one who is of low birth and wicked conduct, O king is infamous and leads to hell.

sa: विद्यामयोऽन्यः पुरुषस्तात कर्ममयोऽपरः। विद्धि चन्द्रमसं दर्शे सूक्ष्मया कलया स्थितम्॥
en: Know that without suffering destruction, the man of knowledge exists for ever like the moon on the last day of the dark fortnight existing in a subtile form.

sa: जाम्बूनदेन दाम्ना च सर्वतः समलंकृतम्। सुवक्त्रखुरनासं च सुकर्णं सुकटीतटम्॥
en: The animal was bedecked all over with ornaments made of the purest gold. Its face and hoofs and nose and ears were beautiful and its waist too wellformed.

sa: जाजलिरुवाच विक्रीणत: सर्वरसान् सर्वगन्धांश्च वाणिज। वनस्पतीनोषधीश्च तेषां मूलफलानि च॥
en: You sell all sorts of juices and scents, O son of a trader, as also (barks and leaves of) huge trees and herbs and their fruits and roots.

sa: आयुषस्तु चतुर्भागं ब्रह्मचार्यनसूयकः। गुरौ वा गुरुपुत्रे वा वसेद् धर्मार्थकोविदः॥
en: For following the fourth mode of life the Brahmacharya, conversant with the distinctions of duty and shorn of malice, should live with the preceptor or his preceptor's son.

sa: अटव्यां च सुघोरायां तृष्णा” नष्टचेतनः। सरः सुरुचिरप्रख्यमपश्यं पक्षिभिर्वृतम्॥ तत्रावगाढः स्त्रीभूतो दैवेनाहं कृतः पुराः। नामगोत्राणि चाभाष्य दाराणां मन्त्रिणां तथा॥
en: Plunging into that lake for performing my ablutions, I was changed into a woman! Summoning then his wives and counsellors, and all his sons by their names, that best of kings changed into a woman said to them these words: Do you enjoy this kingdom happily. About myself, I shall go to the forest, you sons.

sa: न हिंसयति यो जन्तून् मनोवाक्कायहेतुभिः। जीवितार्थापनयनैः प्राणिभिर्न स हिंस्यते॥
en: He who never injures living creatures by thought, word, or deed, is never injured by such agencies as wild beasts and lawless men always destroying life and property.

sa: तिष्ठन्तं च शयानं च मृत्युरन्वेषते यदा। निर्वृत्तिं लभते कस्मादकस्मान्मृत्युनाशितः॥
en: When Death is seeking you at every moment, it is certain that Death may get you for his victim at any time. Whence will you get your rescue.

sa: अपश्यमानस्तद् द्वारं सर्वतः पिहितो मुनिः। पर्यक्रामद् उह्यमान इतश्चेतश्च तेजसा॥
en: Closed on all sides and unable to find out the outlet pointed out, the asetic began to roam hither and thither. burning all the while with Mahadeva's energy.

sa: इत्युक्तो ब्रह्मणा देवो भागे चापि प्रकल्पिते। भगवन्तं तथेत्याह ब्रह्माणममितौजसम्॥
en: When Brahman had said these words, and when his proper share was appointed of the sacrificial offerings, Mahadeva replied to the Grandfather of great energy, saying,-So be it.

sa: निरपेक्षः शुको भूत्वा नि:स्नेहो मुक्तसंशयः। मोक्षमेवानुसंचिन्त्य गमनाय मनो दधे॥
en: Shuka, however, paid no heed to that request. Freed from affection and all doubt, he began to think only of Liberation, and set his heart on the journey.

sa: तत्पुरे चैकमेवास्य गृहं यदधितिष्ठति। गृहे शयनमप्येकं निशायां यत्र लीयते॥
en: In that palace he has again only one sleeping 'room. In that room he has, again, only one bed on which at night he is to lie down.

sa: एवं स्त्री नापरानोति नर एवापराध्यति। व्युच्चरंश्च महादोषं नर एवापराध्यति॥
en: Then again woman can commit no fault. It is man only who commits commits faults. By committing an act of adultery, the man only becomes sullied with sin.

sa: हिरण्यगर्भो भगवानेष बुद्धिरिति स्मृतः। महानिति च योगेषु विरिञ्चिरिति चाप्यजः॥
en: The eldest-born Being is called Hiranyagarbha. This holy one has been called the Understanding. In the Yoga scriptures, He is called the Great, and Virinchi, and the Unborn.

sa: न हिंस्यात् सर्वभूतानि मैत्रायणगतश्चरेत्। नेदं जीवितमासाद्य वैरं कुर्वीत केनचित्॥
en: One should refrain from injuring any creature, and fact observing the course of the Sun. Having come into this life, one should not treat with unfriendliness any creature.

sa: मातापितृसहस्राणि पुत्रदारशतानि च। अनागतान्यतीतानि कस्य ते कस्य वा वयम्॥
en: Ever one had and will have in this world mothers and fathers and sons and wives, by hundreds and thousands. Who, however, were they and whose are we?

sa: काकोल इव कृष्णाङ्गो रक्ताक्षः कालसम्मितः। दीर्घजको ह्रस्वपादो महावक्त्रो महाहनुः॥
en: He was black as a raven and his eyes were blood red. He looked like Yama himself. He had long legs, short feet, large mouth, and protruding cheeks.

sa: भीष्म उवाच दुराचारा दुर्विचेष्टा दुष्प्रज्ञाः प्रियसाहसाः। असंतस्विति विख्याताः संतश्चाचारलक्षणा:॥
en: Bhishma said Those are called wicked men who are of bad conduct, of bad acts, of wicked understanding, and great rashness, gusihed by purity of conduct and habit.

sa: सोऽपश्यत् काञ्चनद्वारं दीप्यमानमिव श्रिया। मन्दाकिनी च नलिनी धनदस्य महात्मनः॥
en: He then saw a golden gate that seemed to blaze with beauty. He saw also the Mandakini and the Nalini of the great Kubera the Lord of Riches.

sa: प्रकृत्या सर्वमेवेदं जगदन्धीकृतं विभो। रजसा तमसा चैव व्याप्तं सर्वमनेकधा॥
en: O king, the whole of this universe has been blinded by Nature and all things have been variously overwhelmed (through Nature by the qualities of Darkness and Ignorance).

sa: श्रूयते शम्बुके शूद्रे हते ब्राह्मणदारकः। जीवितो धर्ममासाद्य रामात् सत्यपराक्रमात्॥
en: We have heard that a Shudra named Shambuka having been killed and virtue having been upheld by the powerful Rama, a (dead, Brahmana child was restored to life.

sa: पूर्णं वर्षसहस्रं तु तप्तवानेष माधवः। प्रसाद्य वरदं देवं चराचरगुरुं शिवम्॥
en: For a full thousand years this Madhava practised the austerest penances and at last succeeded in pleasing the illustrious and boongiving Shiva, that lord of the mobile and the immobile universe.

sa: इष्टिं वैश्वानरों नित्यं निर्वयेदब्दपर्यये। अनुकल्पः परो परो धर्मो धर्मवादैस्तु केवलम्॥
en: On the expiry of every year, one should celebrate the Vaishyanara sacrifice. Those who are conversant with religious codes say that the practice of an alternative act, does not destroy virtue.

sa: प्रजाः पशृंश्च स्वर्गे च हन्ति यज्ञो ह्यदक्षिणः। इन्द्रियाणि यशः कीर्तिमायुश्चाप्यवकृन्तति॥
en: A sacrifice not completed with Dakshina, encompasses the destruction of one's children, animals, and heaven. Such a sacrifice destroys also the senses, the glory the achievements, and the very life, itself.

sa: एवमेष महान् धर्मः स ते पूर्वं नृपोत्तम। कथितो हरिगीतासु समासविधिकल्पितः॥
en: Even such are the particulars of this great religion. I have, before this, O foremost of kings, explained it to you in the Hari-Gita, with a brief reference to its ordinances.

sa: एतच्चैवाभ्यनुज्ञातं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरैस्तथा। को जातु न विचिन्वीत विद्वान् स्वां शक्तिमात्मनः।।२३।
en: This again has been sanctioned by men of ancient times. What learned man is there who does not sclect, according to his own power, individuals from among living creatures for sacrifice?

sa: अहःसु गण्यमानेषु क्षीयमाणे तथाऽऽयुषि। जीविते लिख्यमाने च किमुत्थाय न धावसि॥
en: As the days are going one after another, and period of your life is being decreased. Indeed, when your life is being continually shortened, why do you not run to preceptors?

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु राजन्नवहितः सर्वमेतद् यथातथम्। यथामति यथा चैतच्छुतपूर्वं मयानघ॥
en: Bhishma said Listen, O king, attentively to all this as it actually took place, O sinless one, I shall describe these masters to you as I have heard and understood them.

sa: गच्छत्येव परित्यागी वानप्रस्थश्च गच्छति। गृहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी च उभौ तावपि गच्छतः॥
en: The Sanyasin attains to a high end. The herinit also attains to a hight end. Both the other two, also, viz., the house-holder and the Brahmacharin, attain to the same end.

sa: अकृतप्रज्ञको बालो मोहं गच्छति जापकः। स मोहान्निरयं याति तत्र गत्वानुशोचति॥
en: The Reciter who is not gifted with wisdom and who is foolish, becomes stupefied or deluded; and for such delusion has to go to hell where he is obliged to grieve.

sa: शब्दः श्रोतं तथा स्वानि त्रयमाकाशसम्भवम्। प्राणश्चेष्टा तथा स्पर्श एते वायुगुणास्त्रयः॥
en: Sound, the sense of hearing, and all the cavities within the body,-these three Originate-from ether. The vital airs, the action of the limbs, and touch are the attributes of the wind.

sa: आराध्य तपसोग्रेण देवं हयशिरोधरम्। पाञ्चालेन क्रमः प्राप्तो देवेन पथि देशिते॥
en: Having worshipped with the austerest penances the illustrious god with the horsehead, the Rishi Panchala acquired the science of Karma by going along the path pointed out by the god (Rudra).

sa: व्यास उवाच द्वितीयमायुषो भागं गृहमेधी गृहे वसेत्। धर्मलब्धैर्युतो दारैरग्नीनाहृत्य सुव्रतः॥
en: Vayasa said Performing meritorious vows, ihe house holder, for the second period of his life, should live in his house, having married according to the ordinance and having established a fire.

sa: सहोपनिषदान् वेदान् ये विप्राः सम्यगास्थिताः। पठन्ति विधिमास्थाय ये चापि यतिधर्मिणः॥ तेभ्यो विशिष्टां जानामि गतिमेकान्तिनां नृणाम्। केनैष धर्मः कथितो देवेन ऋषिणापि वा॥
en: The end that is attained by Brahmanas, who, practising due observances, study the Vedas with the Upanishads according to the rules laid down for such study, and by those who follow the Religion of Yatis, is inferior, I think, to that attained by persons devoted whole-mindedly to Hari, Who first promulgated this Religion of Devotion? Was it some god or some Rishi who declared it.

sa: कौशिकानि च वस्त्राणि शुभान्याभरणानि च। वाहनासनपानानि तत् सर्वं तपसः फलम्॥
en: The silken dresses they put on the excellent ornaments that decorate their persons, the animals and vehicles they ride, and the seats they use are all the outcome of their penances.

sa: गृहमागत्य विश्रान्तः स्वजनं परिपृच्छय च। अभ्यगच्छच्च तं विप्रं न्यायत: कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Resting himself for sometime at home and getting the permission of his kinsmen and friends, he then, in a proper way, went, O delighter of the Kurus, to the Brahmana Vadanya.

sa: शुभाशुभान्वितान् भगवान् विसृजन संक्षिपन्नापि। आस्ते देव्या सदाचिन्त्यो यं प्रार्थयसि शत्रुहन्॥
en: Coming into existence and withdrawing once more to himself all things fraught with good and evil, that inconceivable God whom you seek, O destroyer of enemies, lives here with his consort.

sa: यूयं हि तप्ततपसः सर्वे च चरितव्रताः॥ सर्वे वेदविदो मुख्या नैमिषारण्यवासिनः।
en: You have have all practised very penances and observed many high and excellent vows. Living in this sacred forest of Naimisha, you are foremost of all persons conversant with the Vedas.

sa: उपदेशो न कर्तव्यो जातिहीनस्य कस्यचित्। उपदेशे महान् दोष उपाध्यायस्य भाष्यते॥
en: Instruction should not be given to one who belongs to a low or degraded caste. It is said that the preceptor who delivers instruction to such a person commits great sin.

sa: महाभूतानि भूतात्मा महात्मा पुरुषोत्तमः। वायुयॊतिस्तथा चापः खं च गां चान्वकल्पयत्॥
en: He is the soul of all creatures, the great one, and the foremost of all beings. He crealed (by his will) the five elements viz., Wind, Light, Water, Space and Earth.

sa: नारायणेन दृष्टस्तु प्रतिबुद्धो भवेत् पुमान्। एवमात्मेच्छया राजन् प्रतिबुद्धो न जायते॥
en: By following that religion one acquires the highest end by attaining to Liberation which has Narayana for its soul. That person upon whom Narayana looks with mercy succeeds in becoming awakened.

sa: पुमांसमुन्नयेत् प्राज्ञः शयने तप्त आयसे। अप्यादधीत दारूणि तत्र दह्येत पापकृत्॥
en: A wise king should make the male person, committing adultery under such circumstances to be placed upon a heated bed of iron and then, placing woods underneath, burn the sinner thereon.

sa: प्रवेश्यात्मनि चात्मानं योगी तिष्ठति योऽचलः। पापं हन्ति पुनीतानां पदमाप्नोति सोऽजरम्॥
en: The Yogin who stay immovably after having entered his self into the soul, dissipates his sins and gets at that indestructible spot which is the possession of those who are pious.

sa: एतदाचष्ट मे राजन् देवर्षिर्नारदः पुरा। व्यासश्चैव महायोगी संजल्पेषु पदे पदे॥
en: The celestial Rishi Narada and the great Yogin Vyasa had again and again told all this to me in days of yore when the subject was suggested in course of conversation.

sa: व्यासश्चकथयत् प्रीत्या धर्मपुत्राय धीमते। स एवायं मया तुभ्यमाख्यातः प्रसृतो गुरोः॥
en: Pleased with Dharma's son Yudhisthira, Vyasa imparted this religion to king Yudhisthira the just who was endued with great intelligence. Derived from my preceptor I have also communicated it to you.

sa: ततः प्रीतो जलधरः कृतकार्णे युधिष्ठिर। ईप्सितं मनसो लब्ध्वा वरमन्यैः सुदुर्लभम्॥
en: The Cloud, Kundadhara, became pleased,O Yudhishthira, at thus having been successful in gaining his wish. The boon that he had got was one that could not be acquired by anybody else.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां सुखार्थं हि त्वं पाहि वसुधां नृप। यथैवैतान् पुराऽऽक्षेप्सीस्तथैवैतान् प्रसादय॥
en: Do you govern the Earth, O king, for the sake of the Brahmanas and for the sake of happiness. You used formerly to blame the Brahmanas. Do you please them now.

sa: परिवित्तिः परिवेत्ता या चैव परिविद्यते। पाणिग्रहास्त्वधर्मेण सर्वे ते पतिताः स्मृताः॥
en: If a young brother marries before his elder brother, then the younger brother, the elder brother, and the woman that is married, all three, on account of such wedding, become degraded.

sa: गृहस्थस्त्वेष धर्माणां सर्वेषां मूलमुच्यते। यत्र पक्वकषायो हि दान्तः सर्वत्र सिध्यति॥
en: A house-holder's life is said to be the root of all the other modes of life. A self-controlled house-holder who has mastered all his attachments of worldly objects always becomes successful.

sa: त्यरत्वा मूलफलं सर्वं पर्णाहारोऽभवद् द्विजः। पर्णं त्यक्त्वा जलाहारः पुनरासीद् द्विजस्तदा।॥
en: By and bye the Brahmana, leaving off fruits and roots, began to use leaves of trees as his food. Then leaving off leaves, he took to water only as his subsistence.

sa: चत्वार्याहुः सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तत्कृतं युगम्। तस्य तावच्छती संध्या संध्यांशश्च तथाविधः॥
en: Four thousand celestial years is the duration of the first or Krita age. The morning of that cycle consists of four hundred years and its evening is of four hundred years.

sa: श्रुते वयसि जातौ च सद्भावो नाधिगम्यते। एष्वर्थेषूत्तरं तस्मात् प्रवेद्यं मत्समागमे॥
en: No one can, without questioning, determine another's proficiency in the scriptures, or age, or order of birth. You should, therefore, answer these questions of mine, when you have come to me.

sa: ब्रह्मण्य इति मामाहस्तया वाचाऽस्मि तोषितः। एतदेव पवित्रेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः परमं स्मृतम्॥
en: People used to call me as one devoted to the Brahmanas. This address always pleased me highly. To do good to the Brahmanas is the most sacred of all sacred duties.

sa: कल्याणं कुरुते बाढं पापमस्मिन्न विद्यते। न प्रीयते परानर्थस्तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: He is, forsooth, always employed in doing good to all people. No sin is in him. He never rejoices at other people's misfortunes. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

sa: सर्वेण खलु मर्तव्यं मर्त्यलोके प्रसूयता। कृतान्तविहिते मार्ग मृतं को जीवयिष्यति॥
en: In this world of mortals, everyone who is born is sure to die. Who shall restore to life one that is dead and gone on the way ordained by the destroyer?

sa: यथा चोत्तापितं बीजं कपाले यत्र तत्र वा। प्राप्याप्यकुरहेतुत्वमबीजत्वान्न जायते॥ तद्वद् भगवतानेन शिखा प्रोक्तेन भिक्षुणा। ज्ञानं कृतमबीजं मे विषयेषु न जायते॥
en: As a seed, fried on a pan or otherwise, becomes unfit to sprout forth although the power for sprouting lies there, similarly my understanding having been freed from the productive principle formed by desire, by the instructions of the holy Panchashikha of the mendicant order, it no longer gives its fruit in the form of attachment to the objects of the senses.

sa: ततस्तौ तपसां वासौ यशसां तेजसामपि॥ ऋषी शमदमोपेतौ कृत्वा पौर्वाह्निकं विधिम्।
en: After this, those two Rishis that were the abode of penances, of famous deeds, and of energy,-those ascetics that were gifted with tranquillity of heart and self-control, performed their morning rites.

sa: न हिंस्यात् सर्वभूतानि मैत्रायणगतश्चरेत्। नेदं जन्म समासाद्य वैरं कुर्वीत केनचित्॥
en: One should not injure any creature. On the other hand, one should treat with friendliness to all. Having acquired the status of humanity, one should never treat inimically to any one.

sa: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शुकः परमबुद्धिमान्। संचिन्त्य मनसा धीरो निश्चयं नाध्यगच्छत॥
en: Hearing these words of Narada, Shuka, gifted with great intelligence and possessed of tranquillity of mind, reflected upon the drift of the instructions he received, but could not deterinine any thing.

sa: साहं वै पङ्कजे जाता सूर्यरश्मिविबोधिते! भूत्यर्थं सर्वभूतानां पद्मा श्री: पद्ममालिनी॥
en: I am that Padma, that Shree adorned with lotuses, who originated from the lotus that blooms at the touch of the rays of the Sun-god, for the prosperity of all creatures.

sa: भीष्म उवाच नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा व्यासः परमधर्मवित्। तथेत्युवाच संहृष्टो वेदाभ्यासदृढव्रतः॥
en: Bhishma continued Hearing these words of Narada, Vyasa, the best of all persons knowing duties and firmly devoted to Vedic recitation, became filled with joy and answered Narada, saying,-So be it.

sa: स पुत्रान् बहुलान् दृष्ट्वा विपुले कर्मणि स्थितः। कुलधर्माश्रितो राजन् धर्मचर्यास्थितोऽभवत्॥
en: Observing that he had many children, the Brahmana began to perform religious acts on a large scale. His religious observances, O king, were according to the customs of his own family.

sa: अन्नपानानि जीर्यन्ते यत्र भक्षाश्च भक्षिताः। तस्मिन्नेवोदरे गर्भ: किं नान्नमिव जीर्यते॥
en: That part of the body into which the food that is eaten goes and where it is digested, is the place where the embryo lives, but it is not disgested there.

sa: आयुर्न सुलभं लब्वा नावकर्षेद् विशाम्पते। उत्कर्षार्थं प्रयतेत नरः पुण्येन कर्मणा॥
en: Having got the allotted period of life, O king, with such difficulty, one should not diminish it. On other hand, man should always try, by righteous deeds, for his gradual advancement.

sa: अकल्ककस्य विप्रस्य रौक्ष्यात् करकृतात्मनः। वटवो यस्य भिक्षन्ति तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as beg food from the hands of even a poor person of their caste who has just got something from others, one acquires great merit.

sa: आसीनं देवलं वृद्धं बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमतां वरम्। नारदः परिपप्रच्छ भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययम्॥
en: Once on a time Narada, seeing that foremost of intelligent men, viz., Devala of venerable years, seated at his ease, asked him about the origin and the destruction of all creatures.

sa: स कदाचित् समुद्रान्ते कस्मिश्चिद् गिरिगह्वरे। बलिं वैरोचनि वज्री ददर्शोपससर्य च॥
en: One day, while thus engaged, the holder of the thunderbolt was Virochana's son Vali within a certain mountain cave on the seashore. Seeing the king of Danavas, he came near him.

sa: ततो रागः प्रभवति द्वेषश्च तदनन्तरम्। ततो लोभः प्रभवति मोहश्च तदनन्तरम्॥
en: The mind of one possessed by greed and mistake and affected by attachment and hatred is never bent to virtue. One then begins with hypocrisy to do deeds which are good.

sa: स्वमपत्यं विशिष्टं हि सर्व इच्छत्यनाविलम्। व्यक्तं भगवता चात्र कृतमेवं भविष्यति॥
en: Every one wishes to possess an excellent and pure son. The illustrious Richika too must have acted from the same motive in this matter as will appear in the long run.

sa: आत्मानं च विशेषेण प्रशंसाम्यनपायिनी। यस्य मे त्वं विशालाक्षि भार्या गुणसमन्विता॥
en: I praise my own self greatly since, O largeeyed one, I am fortunate enough to have you as my wife,-you who are possessed of every virtue and who have inexhaustible merits.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शतक्रतुरथापश्यद् बलेर्दीप्तां महात्मनः। स्वरूपिणी शरीराद्धि निष्कामन्तीं तदा श्रियम्॥
en: Bhishma said “After this, the god of a hundred sacrifices saw the goddess of Prosperity, in her own embodied, but shining, form, issue out of the body of the great Vali.

sa: क्वासौ क्वासाविति प्राह गृहीत्वा परमायुधम्। उशना दूरतस्तस्य बभौ ज्ञात्वा चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: Having taken up that foremost of weapons, the great god began to say, Where is he? Where is he?—Meanwhile, Ushanas, having learnt the purpose of Mahadeva from a distance, waited silently.

sa: कर्मजं त्विह मन्यन्ते फलयोगं शुभाशुभम्। कर्मणां विषयं कृत्स्नमहं वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु॥
en: In this world all fruits, good or bad, that attach themselves to persons, are considered as the outcome of acts. I shall now describe fully the subject of acts. Hear me.

sa: वयं सृष्टा हि भगवंस्त्वया च प्रभविष्णुना। येन यस्मिन्नधीकारे वर्तितव्यं पितामह॥
en: Addressing the Grandfather, they said,-We have been created, O holy one, by you, O you of great power. Tell us, O Grandfather, which of us should be vested with what jurisdiction.

sa: इन्द्रियैर्गृह्यते यद् यत् तत् तद् व्यक्तमिति स्थितिः। अव्यक्तमिति विज्ञेयं लिङ्गग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम्॥
en: All objects that are perceived by the senses are called Manifest. Whatever objects are above the senses and are apprehended by means only of their marks are said to be Unimanifest.

sa: ये तु तस्यैव देवस्य प्रादुर्भावाः सुरप्रियाः। भविष्यन्ति त्रिलोकस्थास्तेषां स्वतीत्यथो द्विज॥
en: We are thus employed, O twice-born one, moved by the desire of benefiting those manifestations of the Supreme God, dear to all the celestials, that will appear in the three worlds.

sa: सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेतदन्तरं पश्य सूक्ष्मयोः। सृजते तु गुणानेक एको न सृजते गुणान्॥
en: Mark the differences between those two subtile things, viz., Intelligence and the Soul. One of these viz., Intelligence (displays of qualities. The other viz., the Soul) does nothing of the kind.

sa: अथवा मनसः सङ्गं पश्येद् भूतानुकम्पया। तत्राप्युपेक्षां कुर्वीत ज्ञात्वा कर्मफलं जगत्॥
en: Again, if his mind is filled with attachment for mercy to creatures, he should, seeing that the universe is the result of acts, one should show indifference even to mercy itself.

sa: यस्मादाप्यायते सोमो निधिर्दिव्योऽमृतस्य च। षष्ठः परिवहो नाम स वायुर्जयतां वरः॥
en: Through the action of that wind, the Moon, after waning increases again till he shows his full disc. That wind is known, O foremost of ascetics, by the name of Parivaha.

sa: चिराभिपन्नः कविभिः पूर्वं धर्म उदाहृतः। तेनाचारेण पूर्वेण संस्था भवति शाश्वती॥
en: It seems, therefore, that only that which the learned of old denominated righteousness is righteousness to this day; and through that course of conduct the distinctions and limitations have become eternal.

sa: प्रत्याख्याय पुनर्यातमब्रवीद् राजसत्तमः। शुल्कं प्रदीयतां मह्यं ततो वत्स्यसि मे सुताम्॥
en: But when the latter, thus dismissed, was going away, the excellent king, addressing him, said If you can give me a marriage dower you will have my daughter as your wife!

sa: तेवैवान्यः प्रभवति सोऽपरं बाधते पुनः। दृश्यते चैव स पुनस्तुल्यरूपो यदृच्छया॥
en: By a certain action, one becomes really meritorious. The same actions prevent another from the acquisition of merit. Another, by performing those actions at his pleasure, it is seen, remains unchanged.

sa: भीष्म उवाच दममेव प्रशंसन्ति वृद्धाः श्रुतिसमाधयः। सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषतः॥
en: Bhishma said The ancients who had there minds, directed to the Shrutis, spoke highly of the duty of selfcontrol for all the castes in general, but for the Brahmanas in especial.

sa: ततो रक्षः :पति घोरं पुलस्त्यकुलपांसनम्॥ हरिष्ये रावणं रौद्रं सगणं लोककण्टकम्।
en: I shall then kill the dreadful king of the Rakshasas, that wretch of Pulastya's race, viz., the fierce Ravana, that thorn of all worlds, together with all his children and followers.

sa: भीष्म उवाच निष्कल्मषं ब्रह्मचर्यमिच्छता चरितुं सदा। निद्रा सर्वात्मना त्याज्या स्वप्नदोषानवेक्षता॥
en: Bhishma said The Yogin who wishes to always practise pure Brahmacharya and who is cognizant of the faults attaching to dreams, should, with his whole heart, try to give up sleep.

sa: अज्ञानप्रभवो मोहः पापाभ्यासात् प्रवर्तते। यदा प्राज्ञेषु रमते तदा सद्यः प्रणश्यति॥
en: Loss of judgement originates from ignorance and sinfulness of habit. When the man whom this fault attacks begins to find pleasure in wise men, the vice at once and immediately disappears.

sa: अव्यक्तस्य परं प्राहुर्विद्यां वै पञ्चविंशकम्। सर्वस्य सर्वमित्युक्तं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानस्य पार्थिव॥
en: Above Nature is the twenty-fifth (Soul) who should be known as Vidya. Of all Knowledge, that which is the Object of Knowledge has been said to be the Unmanifest, O king.

sa: विषमुटबन्धनं दाहो दस्युहस्तात् तथा वधः। दंष्ट्रिभ्यश्च पशुभ्यश्च प्राकृतो वध उच्यते॥
en: The death that one meets with by taking poision, by hanging, by burning, at the hands of robbers and at the teeth of animals, is said to be an infamous one.

sa: एष ते भरतश्रेष्ठ नृशंसः परिकीर्तितः। सदा विवर्जनीयो हि पुरुषेण विजानता।॥
en: I have now, O foremost of Bharatas, said to you what the marks are of the wicked and malevolent man. Such a person should always be shunned by a wise man.

sa: ते चोदिताः पार्थिवसत्तमेन ततः प्रहृष्टाः जगृहुः प्रदीपान्। देवर्षिगन्धर्वसुरर्षिसङ्घा विद्याधराश्चाप्सरसां गणाच॥
en: In obedience to the command of that foremost of kings they gladly took (burning) lamps, in their hands. large numbers of celestials, sages, Gandharvas and Rishis and hosts of Vidyadharas, Apsaras.

sa: तदिदं मम भद्रं ते शोकस्थानमरिंदम। अर्जुनार्थे महाबाहो सात्वतस्य च कारणात्॥
en: Good betide you! O slayer of foes, this indeed is the cause of my grief, O mighty armed one, for the sake of Arjuna and for that of the Satvata hero.

sa: गोत्राणां नामधेयानां कुलानां चैव मारिष। श्रवणाद्धि विजानीमः पञ्चालान् कुरुभिः सह॥
en: And, O worshipful sire, (in that terrible encounter) we could only distinguish the Kurus from the Panchalas by the names of their (respective) clans and families which we heard them utter.

sa: दब्राह्मणे ब्रह्म न हि ध्रुवं स्यात्। मस्मिन् संग्रामे तुमुलेऽतीव भीमे॥
en: When the hour of your death will arrive. Brahmastra can never live in one who is not a Brahmana. I have forgotten that great weapon in this fierce and dreadful encounter.

sa: तयोर्ध्वजौ वीतमलौ शुशुभाते रथे स्थितौ। राहुकेतू यथाऽऽकाशे उदितौ जगतः क्षये॥
en: Like the planets Rahu and Ketu appearing in the sky at the time of the destruction of the whole world the banners of those two heroes looked very brilliant and beautiful.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तयोरत्यद्भुतं नृप। यथा पूर्वे महद् युद्धं शम्बरामरराजयोः॥
en: O king, the battle that was then fought between them, was indeed marvellous and it resembled that fought between Shambara and the chief of the immortals in the days of yore.

sa: ततो हाहाकृते सैन्ये दृष्ट्वा भीमं नृपाऽब्रुवन्। रुद्रोऽयं भीमरूपेण धार्तराष्ट्रेषु युध्यति॥
en: Then your troops began to wail aloud and the kings seeing Bhima, said. "He is Rudra himself who assuming the shape of a Bhima is fighting with the troops of Dhritarashtra.”

sa: पराङ्मुखाय दीनाय न्यस्तशस्त्राय सात्यके। क्षत्रधर्मरतः प्राज्ञः कथं नु प्रहरेद् रणे॥
en: How can a wise person, practising the Kshatriya duties, strike in battle one who runs away or is helpless or has laid aside his weapons or who begs (for his life)?

sa: यत् तु विद्वन् प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रत्ययार्थमहं तव। आत्मनः स्तवसंयुक्तं तन्निबोध यथातथम्॥
en: O wise one, whatever I will speak with a view to draw out your confidence, all that is full of self-praise. Be what it may, do you listen to it properly.

sa: सैन्धवं निहतं मेने फाल्गुनेन महात्मना॥ ततो वादित्रघोषेण स्वान् योधान् पर्यहर्षयत्।
en: Considered the ruler of the Sindhus to be slain by the high-souled Phalguna. Then he son imparted delight to his own warriors by means of the sound of his musical instruments.

sa: न चापि तस्य क्रुद्धस्य वार्ष्णेयस्य महात्मनः॥ स्थास्यते प्रत्यनीकेषु कश्चिदत्र नृपस्तव।
en: There exists no king in our whole army, who will be able to stand in the front of that high-souled descendant of Vrishni's race, when he will be filled with wrath.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा चुक्रुधे भीमो जगृहे भारसाधनान्॥ एकमेकं समुद्दिश्य पातयामास मर्मसु।
en: Filled with ire on beholding them, Bhima, aiming at each of them one after the other, struck each of them in the vital parts with arrows capable of bearing much strain.

sa: प्रविश्य तु रणे राजन् केशवः परवीरहा। सेनामध्ये हयांस्तूर्णं चोदयामास भारत॥
en: Then having taken the chariot to the thick of the fight, that slayer of hostile heroes, Keshava, O Bharata, quickly drove the steeds of it into the ranks of the soldiers.

sa: जीवत्सु पाण्डुपुत्रेषु तद्धि सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते॥ आत्मार्थं युध्यमानास्ते समर्थाः पाण्डुनन्दनाः।
en: So long as the sons of Pandu are alive. What I tell you is true. The sons of Pandu are fighting for their own sake and they are very competent also.

sa: ऋषयस्तत्र देवेशं स्तुवन्तो बहुभिः स्तवैः। तेजश्चास्मै वर्धयन्तो राजन्नासन् पुनः पुनः॥
en: There the great Rishi began to praise that Lord of the celestials with numerous kinds of hymns; as also they were repeatedly increasing His energy and stood up there, O monarch.

sa: तेऽपतन्त हता बाणैर्नानारूपैः किरीटिना। सविमाना यथा सिद्धाः स्वर्गात् पुण्यक्षये तथा॥
en: As Siddhas (pure souls) are obliged to have a fall from heaven with their cars, when their virtues wear off, so those warriors were all knocked down by Kiriti's various weapons.

sa: ध्रुवः सर्वाणि भूतानि विष्णुः पाति जनार्दनः। इङ्गितज्ञाश्च मगधाः प्रेक्षितज्ञाश्च कोसलाः॥
en: The Magadhas are conversánt with hints, the Koshalas can understand what they see. The Kurus and Panchalas can understand halfexpressed words. The Shalyas cannot understand till the whole thing is expressed.

sa: मन्दरः पर्वतश्चाक्षो जङ्घा तस्य महानदी॥ दिशश्च प्रदिशश्चैव परिवारो रथस्य तु।
en: The Mandara mountain was made the axle of that car; and the great river (the Ganges) constituted its Jangha; and the different directions and the subsidiary points constituted its several ornaments.

sa: एवमेष क्षयो वृत्तः पाण्डवानां ततस्ततः। तावकानामपि रणे भीमं प्राप्य महाबलम्॥
en: And thus the losses which attended the Pandava forces in their several divisions, were equal to those of your own, when the allpowerful Bhima joined them (the Pandavas) in the field.

sa: देवानामिव देवेन्द्र जयाशा त्वयि मे स्थिता। नहि मातुल कौन्तेयानसुरानिव पावकिः॥
en: My hopes of victory rest on you as those of the gods rest on their lord Indra. O uncle, slay the sons of Kunti, even as Pabaka's son slew the Asuras."

sa: येन रूपेण दैत्यस्यु येन वेषेण चैव ह॥ मृतस्तस्यां परिक्षिप्तस्तादृशेनैव जज्ञिवान्।
en: Indeed, the Daityas, in whatever form and whatever guise they were slaughtered, after having been dipped into that lake, had come back to their life in the same form and guise.

sa: अद्य निर्धार्तराष्ट्रां च भ्रात्रे दास्यामि मेदिनीम्॥ निरर्जुनां वा पृथिवीं केशवनुचरिष्यसि।
en: O Keshava, today, either I will, making the earth devoid of Dhartarashtras, make a gift of her unto my brothers, or you shall have to traverse this ground shorn of Arjuna.

sa: ब्रह्मक्षत्रस्य विहिताः सूता वै परिचारकाः। न क्षत्रियोवै सूतानां शृणुयाच कथञ्चन॥
en: Then, again, the charioteers, indeed are servants to the Kshatriyas; but never the Kshatriyas, O sinless one, are servants to the charioteer class. Do you, therefore, listen to these my words.

sa: तदद्भुतं शैल इवाप्रकम्पो वर्षं महाशैलसमानसारः। विध्वंसयामास रणे नरेन्द्र वैकर्तनः शत्रुगणावमर्दी॥
en: O foremost of kings, then Vikartana's son Karna, that crusher of his foes, immovable like a hill and equal to a hill in personal proportions, destroyed that wonderful shower of arrows.

sa: इदं तु यदतिक्षुद्रं वार्ष्णेयार्थे कृतं त्वया। वासुदेवमतं नूनं नैतत् त्वय्युपपद्यते॥
en: This vile act that you have today perpetrated for the sake of the Vrishni hero, is surely the result of Vasudeva's instigations. And it cannut possibly be reconciled to your nature.

sa: कर्णमाश्रित्य कौन्तेय धार्तराष्ट्रेण विग्रहः॥ रोचितो भवता सार्धं जानतापि बलं तव।
en: O son of Kunti, it is through having secured the aid of Karna that Dhritarashtra's son has ventured to fight with you, though he is full well aware of your prowess.

sa: कवचेन विहीनश्च कुण्डलाभ्यां च पाण्डव। सोऽद्य मानुषतां प्राप्तो विमुक्तः शक्रदत्तया॥
en: Deprived of his armour and his two earrings, O son of Pandu and haring given up his Sakti given to him by Shakra, Karna today is nothing more then a mortal.

sa: साश्वध्वजरथः संख्ये धृतराष्ट्र पतेद् भुवि। विना जनार्दनं पार्थो योगानीमीश्वरं प्रभूम्॥
en: O Dhritarashtra, Partha, with his horse, charioteer and standard, would have been completely destroyed in battle, had he been deprived of the aid of Jannardana, that lord of all yoga prowess.

sa: अद्य दुर्योधन त्वां नन्दयिष्ये सबान्धवम्। निहत्य समरे वीरमर्जुनं जयतां वरम्॥
en: Today, O Duryodhana, I will gratify your heart, along with that of your friends by slaughter in the field of battle the heroic Arjuna that foremost one amongst the victorious warriors.

sa: वृषभस्कन्धविक्रान्तो वृषभाक्षो नरर्षभः। तावकानां बभौ मध्ये गवां मध्ये यथा वृषः॥
en: That foremost of men graced with shoulders, tread and eyes, resembling those of the moon, appeared in the centre of your army, like a bull in the midst of a cowpen.

sa: सहसास्त्रविसर्गेण वयं तेनाद्य वञ्चिताः। श्वस्तवहं तस्य संकल्प सर्वं हन्ता महीपते॥
en: Today we were all deceived by him (Arjuna) by the shower of weapons poured forth all on a sudden. But tomorrow, O ruler of earth, I will baffle all his attempts.'

sa: ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्हमपट्टविभूषितम्। परिघं घोरमादाय मृत्युदण्डमिवापरम्॥ कर्णस्य निधनाकाङ्क्षी चिक्षेपातिबलो नदन्।
en: Then taking up a dreadful Parigha adorned with gold resembling the rod of death the mighty-armed Bhima, with a view to kill Karna, hurled it at him making a great roar.

sa: एष शिष्यः सखा चैव तव सत्यपराक्रमः। सर्वान् योधांस्तृणीकृत्य विजिग्ये पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: O your of true prowess, Satyaki is your friend and pupil. That foremost of men, holding all the warriors of the hostile host a pins fee, has vanquished them all. near

sa: वज्राशनिसमा घोराः परकायावभेदिनः। शराः कुर्वन्ति ते नार्थं पार्थ काऽद्य विडम्बना॥
en: O son of Pritha what misfortune is this that your arrows, dreadful like the bolt of Heaven and capable of piercing through the body of the enemy, produce no effect today?

sa: पुत्रव्यसनसंतप्तो निराशो जीवितेऽभवत्॥ आगस्कृतमिवात्मानं पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। ऋषिवाक्येन मन्वानः श्रुत्वा च निहतं सुतम्॥ विचेताः परमोद्विग्नो धृष्टद्युम्नमवेक्ष्य च। योद्धु नाशक्नुवद् राजन् यथापूर्वमरिदम्॥
en: Overwhelmed with grief on account of the supposed death of his son, gave way to despair. Hearing the words of the sages, great offender against the illustrious Pandavas. Now hearing that his son had been slain he became completely senseless and filled with anxiety at the sight of Dhristadyumna, O monarch, the chastiser of foes was not able to fight as before.

sa: संनिरुद्धं रणे द्रोणं पञ्चाला वीक्ष्य मारिष। आवत्रुः सर्वतो राजन् धर्मपुत्रजयैषिणः॥
en: O sire, then beholding Drona held in check, the Panchalas surrounded him O king, on all son sides, desirous as they were of securing victory to the very virtuous king Yudhishthira.

sa: ते हता न्यपतन् भूमौ धृष्टद्युम्नस्य वाजिनः। शोणास्तु पर्यमुच्यन्त रथबन्धाद् विशाम्पते॥
en: The steeds of Dhristadyumna, thus slain fell down on the ground, whereupon the red steeds of Drona himself were set free from the entanglement in the trappings, O ruler of men.

sa: तथोक्त्वा योगमास्थाय ज्योतिर्भूतो महातपाः। पुराणं पुरुषं विष्णुं जगाम मनसा परम्॥
en: Having spoken as before, Drona, had betaken to yoga. Endued with great splendour and possessed of ascetic merit, he had set his heart on that ancient and paramount being viz., Vishnu.

sa: उभयेनैव ते हीना नाविन्दन् धृतिमात्मनः। अन्विच्छन्तः शरीरं तु भारद्वाजस्य पार्थिवाः॥
en: The Kurus lost the benefit of this as well as of the next world. Really they lost all selfcontrol. The rulers of earth then searching for the body of Bharadvaja's son.

sa: स युध्यमानान् पृतनामुखस्थान् शूरः शूरान् हर्षयन् सव्यसाची। पूर्वप्रहारैर्मथितान् प्रशंसन् स्थिरांश्चकारत्मरथाननीके॥
en: Cheering up the warriors that were still fighting at the heads of their respective detachments and speaking highly of their former successes Arjuna enjoined his carwarriors to be at their posts.

sa: विव्याध च तथा सूतं चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्। धनुर्ध्वजं च संयत्तश्चिच्छेद कृतहस्तवत्॥
en: He pierced his opponent's driver and the four horses with four arrows; and then like one endued with great lightness of hand, he cut-off his bow and standard with well-armed shafts.

sa: एवमुक्त्वार्करश्म्याभं सुतीक्ष्णं तं शरोत्तमम्। व्यसृज्यत् सात्वते द्रौणिर्वज्रं वृत्रे यथा हरिः॥
en: Having thus spoken, Drona's son hurled at that scion of the Satvata race an excellent arrow of the effulgence of the solar rays, like Hari (Indra) hurling the thunder-bolt against Vritra.

sa: तत: क्रुद्धो रणे कर्णः कृत्वा घोरतरं वपुः। पाण्डवं छादयामास समन्ताच्छरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Thereupon Karna, who was highly enraged, after having assumed a very terrible look in the field of battle, shrouded the son of Pandu with showers of shafts shot from all sides,

sa: यस्मिञ्जयाशां पुत्राणां सममन्यत पार्थिवाः। तस्मिन् हते स कौरव्यः कथं प्राणानधारयत्॥
en: How could that royal descendant of Kuru hold his life, after having heard of the fall of that hero, on whom he supposed the hope of his sons' victory to rest?

sa: ततो धर्मसुतो राजन् प्रगृह्यान्यन्महद् धनुः॥ द्रौणिं विव्याधं सप्तत्या बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्।
en: Upon that, О king, the son of Dharma took up a very big bow and darted, one after another, seventy shafts, piercing the arms and breast of the son of Drona.

sa: सात्यकिस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो द्रौणेः प्रहरतो रणे॥ अर्धचन्द्रेण तीक्ष्णेन धनुश्छित्त्वानदद् भृशम्।
en: Then Satyaki, filled with anger, roared aloud and broke down in that very battle the bow of that terrible afflicter, Drona's son, with the same-circular and sharp arrow of his own.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भल्लाभ्यामच्छिनद् धनुः॥ तव पुत्रस्य कौरव्य यतमानस्य संयुगे।
en: Thereafter king Yudhishthira cut-off with a Pair of Vallas the bow of your son, who had been exerting to the best of his prowess in battle, O foremost of the Kurus.

sa: प्राप्तवान् परम् दुखं पुत्रव्यसनजं महत्। तस्मिन् यदुक्तवान् काले तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः॥
en: He (the monarch) attained exceedingly great uneasiness in the mind) arising from the fault of his sons. Relate to me, as I ask you, what did he say at that time.

sa: स हि वीरो महेष्वासो मित्राणामभयंकरः॥ शेते विनिहतो वीरो देवेन्द्रेण इवाचलः।
en: That heroic and mighty bowman, conferred fearlessness on my sons; and that warlike one, being in battle, lies on the ground like a mountain pierced by the lord of the celestials.

sa: के क्षुद्राः प्राद्रवंस्ततः। कथं च वः समेतानां हतः कर्णो महारथः॥
en: What heroes did not forsake Karna and what mean-minded men flew away from him? While you had been present in the field, how could that mighty car-warrior be slain in battle?

sa: ततो भीमः स्मरन् क्लेशानक्षद्यूते वनेऽपि च। विराटनगरे चैव दुःखं प्राप्तमरिंदमः॥
en: Then that subduer of foes, viz., Bhima remembering the hardships undergone by him at the game of dice, during his exile in the woods and residence in the city of Virata;

sa: व्यूहं व्यूह्य महेष्वासो मकरं शत्रुतापनः। प्रत्युद्ययौ तथा कर्णः पाण्डवान् विजिगीषया॥
en: Then Karna, that powerful bowman, that siniter of enemies, having arranged the troops in the from of a Makara, started against the Pandavas with the object of winning victory (over them).

sa: अहो शौर्येण सम्पन्नावुभौ चोग्रपराक्रमौ। अहो भीमबलो भीम एतस्य च कृतास्त्रताः॥
en: O! both of them are endowed with heroism; and also they are of terrible prowess. 'O! Bhima is of fierce strength. O! what a great skill is possessed by the other.

sa: अपनीते तु योगेन केनचिच्छ्वेतवाहने। तत एष्यति मे राजन् वशमेष युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: If however by any means Arjuna owning white steeds cab be taken away from the side of Yudhishthira , then, O king, even today may Yudhishthira be brought under your sway.

sa: स त्वायुषि परिक्षीणे जगामानीप्सितां गतिम्। गोमायुत्वं च सम्प्राप्तो दूषितः पूर्वकर्मणा॥
en: When the lease of his life ran out he obtained an undesirable end. In fact, sullied by the evil deeds of his human life, he was born again as a jackal.

sa: ततो युद्धमभूद् राजेस्तेषां तव च धन्विनाम्॥ रजसा संवृते लोके शरजालसमावृते।
en: Thereat, O king, the fight between your warriors and those of the Pandava, commenced anew. Then the earth became enveloped in a cloud of dust and in a net-work of arrows.

sa: त्वं हि पाणिप्रदानेन वयस्यो मेऽग्निसाक्षिकम्। कृतः प्राणैर्बहुमतः सत्येन च शपाम्यहम्॥
en: I have, in the presence of Fire by giving you my hand, made you my friend. You are dearer to me than life itself. This I swear to you by Truth.

sa: अर्जुनस्य परित्राणं कर्तव्यमिति संयुगे। नाहं शोचामि दाशार्ह गोप्तारं जगतः पतिम्॥
en: The rescue of Arjuna a therefore should be at first effected. I do not grieve for him of the Dasharha race, who is the protector and the Lord of the universe.

sa: एवं स समयं कृत्वा विन्ध्येनामित्रकर्शन। अद्यापि दक्षिणाद् देशाद् वारुणिर्न निवर्तते॥
en: O chastiser of foes, having made this agreement with Vindhya, (he went away) and up to the present day the son of Varuna (Agastya) has not returned from the southern country.

sa: मण्डलं तु समावृत्य विचरन् पृतनामुखे। ध्वजं चिच्छेद च क्रुद्धो द्रोणस्यामित्रकर्षणः॥
en: Then at the head of his division he wheeled in circular motion riding on his chariot. Then filled with rage he cut down the flag-staff of Drona, the grinder of foes.

sa: श्रूयतां चापरो धर्म: सरहस्यो महाफलः। इदं कलियुगं प्राप्य मनुष्याणां सुखावहः॥
en: Listen now to another duty, together with the foundation on which it depends, which yields great merits. In this age of Kali, that duty, if performed gives much happiness to men.

sa: न तेषु प्रतिकर्तव्यं पश्यामि कुरुनन्दन॥ सर्वे शस्त्रभृतां लोकान् गतास्तेऽभिमुखं हताः।
en: I have nothing to do for them, O delighter of the Kurus! Killed with their faces towards battle, they have attained to those regions which reserved for the wielders of weapons.

sa: पीडितं चापि जानामि राज्यमान्मानमेव च। अनेन वचसा तुभ्यं दुःखितस्य जनेश्वर॥
en: I consider my kingdom as a disease, and myself also as afflicted. Plunged though I am in sorrow, what however, is the sue of these words that I am addressing you?

sa: एवमेतद् वद ब्रह्मन् नानृतं वदसेऽनघ। अभिज्ञानं तु किंचित् त्वं समानयितुपर्हसि॥
en: It is even so, Otwice-born one. You should, however, O sinless one, assure me that you do not say what is untrue! You should bring me some signet from my husband.

sa: ततोऽभिपत्य पाञ्चाल्यं संरम्भेणेदमब्रवीत्॥ न त्वां वक्ष्यामि परुषं हनिष्ये त्वां वधक्षमम्।
en: Then advancing furiously upon the Panchala prince he said-"I shall not waste my harsh words on you any longer, but I shall crush you, as you richly deserve to be slaughtered."

sa: अस्मै देया मया सीता वीर्यशुल्का महात्मने। प्रतिज्ञां तर्तुमिच्छामि तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥
en: Upon that high-souled one should I confer Sītā, having prowess assigned for her dower. And in this wise will I free myself from my vow; and this you should permit. 10

sa: वीतशोकभयक्रोधा विपाप्मानस्तथैव च। श्रुत्वेमां तु कथां राजन् न भवन्तीह मानवाः॥
en: O king, (hearing them) they were freed from grief, fear and anger and they were cleansed of their sins. Those men who hear them are freed from the bondage of rebirth.

sa: दैवी सम्पद् विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता। मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव॥
en: Godliness is considered to be the means for emancipation, and demoniacness for bondage of births. You need not grieve, O son of Pandu, for Dushasana you are born to be god-like.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा स नागेन्द्रो बभूवाङ्गुष्ठमात्रकः। तं गृहीत्वा नलः प्रायाद् देशं दावविवर्जितम्॥
en: Having thus addressed the king, the prince of the snakes assumed the size of the thumb. King Nala, having thus taken him up, repaired to a country, free from the conflagration.

sa: अद्यापि मुदिताः सन्तु सुहृदस्तेऽभिषेचने। अद्य भीताः पलायन्तु दुष्प्रदास्ते दिशो दश॥
en: O noble one, to-day let your friends rejoice in consequence of your coronation. To day let those that intend to do you harm, being frightened, fly to the ten cardinal points.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रसीदन्तु भवन्तो मे प्रणतस्याभियाचतः। प्रत्यासन्नव्यसनिनं न पां धिक्कर्तुमर्हथ।॥
en: Yudhishthira said I bow down to you and solicit you humbly, to be pleased with me. You should not cry fie on me. I shall soon cast off my life. not

sa: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे। सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम्॥
en: Listen to me, O mighty armed (I shall declare to you) the five causes for the completion of actions, as told in the Sankhya which treats with the annihilation of actions.

sa: अधिभूतं तथा शब्दो दिशस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। द्वितीयं मारुतो भूतं त्वगध्यात्म च विश्रुता॥
en: As connected with objects, it is sound. The presiding deity (of this) is the quarters. The Wind is the second. As connected with the soul, it is known as the skin.

sa: ततः शुक्लाम्बराः स्नातास्तरुणाः शतमष्ट च। स्नापकाः काञ्चनैः कुम्भैः पूर्णैः समुएतस्थिरे॥
en: There, a hundred and eight orderlies robed in white garments, all washed and of youthful age, approached the king with many a golden jar filled (with water) to the very brim.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते भूमौ भीमः क्रुद्धो विशामप्ते॥ धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन सौबलस्य हसन्निव।
en: His weapon thus falling adrift on the ground, O king, Bhima, inflamed with rage, without any strain rent in twain with a broadpointed arrow the bow of the son of Subala.

sa: न विद्यते यदा मांसं कपोतेन समंधृतम्। तत उत्कृत्तमांसोऽसावारुरोह स्वयं तुलाम्॥
en: When portion after portion of his flesh had been added to weigh against the pigeon and no more flesh was left on his body, he then himself mounted on the scale.

sa: त्वया भूमिः पुरा नष्टा समुद्रात् पुष्करेक्षण। वाराहं वपुराश्रित्य जगदर्थे समुद्धृता॥
en: O lotus-eyed deity, it is you who in the days of yore assuming the form of a boar raised the sunken earth from the sea for the benefit of all creatures.

sa: यद् ब्राह्मणस्य कुशलं तदेव सततं वदेत्। तूष्णीमासीत निन्दायां कुर्वन् भैषज्यमात्मनः॥
en: He should always say only what is pleasant to the Brahmanas. When anything is said against him, he should remain perfectly silent. Such silence is the medical treatment prescribed for him.

sa: न कन्यां याचते कश्चिात्रापि कन्या प्रदीयते। स्वयंग्राहा भविष्यन्ति युगान्ते समुपस्थित्ते॥
en: When this Yuga will come, no one will ask for a girl (for marriage) and no one also will give away a girl. The girls will themselves chocse their own husbands.

sa: अचिन्तयन् कंचिदन्यं यावज्जीवं तथाऽऽचरेत्। एष धर्मः क्षत्रियाणां मतमेतच्च मे सदा॥
en: Without paying regard to any body else, throughout his life he should act thus, this is the duty of the Kshatriyas in my opinion and such has ever been my conduct.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां विशां चैव बहुमृष्टान्नमृद्धिमत्। पूर्णे शतसहस्त्रे तु विप्राणां तत्र भुञ्जताम्॥
en: Large masses of costly sweetmeats were kept ready for both the Brahmanas and the Vaishyas. And when the feeding was over of a hundred thousand Brahmanas, drums and cymbals were beat.

sa: स्वधर्ममनुपश्यन्तो यदि माधव संयुगे। अस्त्रेण निधनं काले प्राप्स्यामः स्वर्ग्यमेव तत्॥
en: If following the duties laid down by my religion, O Madhava, I fall down dead in the field killed by arms in the proper time, it will lead me to heaven.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तद् वै श्रुत्वा भीमसेनः कुरुमध्येऽत्यमर्षणः। स्त्रीगतिः पाण्डुपुत्राणामित्युवाच सुदुर्मनाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing the words, "A woman is the refuge for the sons of Pandu, "uttered in the midst of the Kurus (by Karna), the angry Bhima in great affliction said:

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच भीष्मस्यैतद् वचः श्रुत्वा विस्पताः कुरुपुङ्गवाः। आसन् प्रहृष्टमनसः प्रीतिमन्तोऽभवंस्तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said The princes of the line of Kuru became filled with surprise upon listening to this speech of Bhishma. All of them became pleased in mind and overpowered with joy.

sa: पृच्छन्ति चात्र दातारं वदन्ति पुरुषा भुवि॥ अध्वनि क्षीणगात्राश्च पांसुपादावगुण्ठिताः। तेषामेव श्रमार्तानां यो ह्यन्नं कथयेद् बुधः॥ अन्नदातृसमः सोऽपि कीयंते नात्र संशयः।
en: The tired traveller, with weakened limbs and with feet besmeared with dust, asks for the name of him who gives him food. There are men who answer him by telling him the name. That wise man who informs the toil-worn travellers the name of the persons who give them food is certainly considered equal in virtue as the giver of food himself.

sa: आग्नेयेन तदात्रेण योजयामास सायकम्। स जज्वाल तदा बाणो धनुश्चास्य तदात्मनः॥
en: Then he set a shaft (on his bow-string) reciting a formula for the Agneya* (Belonging to the god of Fire.) weapon; and thereat his arrow as well as bow flamed up.

sa: हिमावदातान् यः सिंहान् नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् बली। निर्वीर्यास्तरसा कृत्वा विचकर्ष बबन्ध च॥
en: Possessed of great prowess, he used quickly to deprive the very lions armed with teeth and claws, of all their ferocity and dragged them and bound them at his own pleasure.

sa: तावुभावम्बरे बाणावन्योन्यमभिजन्नतुः। तेजसा संप्रदीप्ताग्रो कुद्धाविव भुंजगमौ।। तावन्योन्य विनिर्दह्य पेततुः पृथिवीतले॥ निरर्चिषौ भस्मकृतौ न भ्राजेते शरोत्तमौ। तावुभौ दीप्यमानौ स्म न भ्राजेते महीतले॥
en: There like a pair of infuriated serpents, those arrows with their heads flaming in energy, baffled each other in the sky. And burning each other, the shafts fell on the earth; and those best of arrows, shorn of brilliance and reduced to ashes, were deprived of their splendour. And having blazed in the welkin, those two fell down to the earth reft of their lustre.

sa: द्रोणस्तु पाण्डवानी के चकार कदनं महत्। यथा दैत्यगणे विष्णुः सुरासुरनमस्कृतः॥
en: Drona caused a dreadful carnage among the host of the Pandavas, like that which Vishnu the revered of all the celestials and the Asuras, caused among the host of the latter.

sa: पुत्रो गृत्समदस्यापि सुचेता अभवद् द्विजः। वर्चाः सुतेजसः पुत्रो विहव्यस्तस्य चात्मजः॥
en: Gritsamada had a regenerate son of the name of Sutejas. Sutejas had a son of the name of Varchas and the son of Varchas was known by the name of Vihavya.

sa: पाण्डुरुवाच प्रमत्तमप्रमत्तं वा विवृतं जन्ति चौजसा। उपायैर्विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैः : कस्मान्मृग विगर्हसे॥
en: Pandu said: It is well known that men kill deer by various means, without (the least) regard whether they are prepared or unprepared; O deer, you should not, therefore, reprove me.

sa: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्। स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धि विन्दति मानवः॥
en: Worshipping Him, from whom are the life of beings, and by whom all the universe is pervaded, by the performance of his own duty man is sure to attain to perfection.

sa: भीष्म उवाच नास्त्यनन्तं महाराज सर्वं संख्यानगोचरः। पुनर्भावोऽपि विख्यातो नास्ति किंचिदिहाचलम्॥
en: Bhishma said Everything, O great king, has an end. Everything has limits assigned to it! Even rebirth, it is well known, has an end. In this world there is nothing unchangeable.

sa: यत्र वै ब्राह्मणाः सन्ति श्रुतवृत्तोपसंहिताः। तत्र दानफलं पुण्यमिह चामुत्र चाश्नुते॥
en: There where Brahmanas exist, gifted with Vedic learning and conduct people are enabled to acquire the sacred fruits of gifts and to enjoy them both in this world and the next.

sa: योमतां प्राप्य जानीषे राज्यश्रियमनुत्तमाम्। स्थिता मयीति तन्मिथ्या नैषा होकत्र तिष्ठति॥
en: This kingly prosperity which you have acquired and which you consider incomparable, had formerly been possessed by me. It is unsubstantial and unreal. She does not live long in one place.

sa: अपि नो दर्शनादेव भवतोऽभ्युदयो भवेत्। मन्ये भवत्प्रसादोऽयं तद्धि कर्म स्वभावतः॥
en: As regards ourselves we succeed in acquiring prosperity through only seeing personages like you. I think that is due to your favour and originates from the nature of my own acts.

sa: कृष्णसारथिमायन्तं दृष्ट्वा श्वेतहयं रथम्। अर्जुनं चापि योद्धारं त्वदीयाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: Beholding that car having white horses yoked to it and Krishna for its driver coming arrows towards them, with Arjuna as the warrior on it, your troops fled away in fear.

sa: अस्मिन्नहनि यच्छ्रेयश्चिन्त्यतां तन्मया सह । हितं चायतियुक्तं च प्रयतौ वक्तुमर्हथः॥
en: Do you therefore consult with me even today as to what is proper. Do you consider carefully and tell me what is auspicious and productive of well-being in the long run.

sa: लङ्कापुनर्निरालम्बा देवदुर्गा भयावहा। नादेयं पार्वतं चान्यं कृत्रिमं च चतुर्विधम् ॥
en: And dreadful and resembling a celestial citadel, Lankā cannot be ascended by means of any support. She has fortresses composed of streams, those of hills, and artificial ones of four kinds.

sa: समभ्युपेत्याद्भुतघोरवीर्य स कुम्भकर्णो युधि वानरेन्द्रम्। जहार सुग्रीवमभिप्रगृह्य यथानिलो मेघमिव प्रचण्डः॥
en: Then Kumbhakarna coming to the wonderfully mighty master of monkeys, took him up and stole away from the field, as a violent gust of wind steal away a patch of cloud.

sa: मुनिरुवाच उपपन्नस्त्वमेतेन यथा क्षत्रिय भाषसे। प्रकृत्या ह्युपपन्नोऽसि बुद्ध्या वा बहुदर्शनः॥
en: The sage said-These words, O Kshatriya. which you give vent to, point you out as a pious men. Indeed, you are pious by nature and understanding, O you of great experience.

sa: निवर्तस्व कुरुश्रेष्ट भीमसेनादिभिः सह। धर्मे ते धीयतां बुद्धिर्मनस्तु महदस्तु च॥
en: Do you cease to follow me, O foremost one of Kuru's race, along with Bhima and others. Let your understanding be always devoted to virtue. Let your mind be always great.

sa: स्वप्ने सुप्तान्नयन्तीं तां रात्रिष्वन्यासु मारिष। ददृशुर्योधमुख्यास्ते जन्तं द्रौणिं च सर्वदा॥
en: On previous days, ( sire the leading warriors, of the Pandava camp used to see in their dreams that figure carrying away the sleeping warriors and Drona's son striking them behind.

sa: कीर्तिश्च जीवतः साध्वी पुरुषस्येति विद्धि तत्। प्रत्याख्येयस्त्वया तात कुण्डलार्थे सुरेश्वरः॥
en: Know that fame is useful to a person so long as he is alive. Therefore, O son, you must refuse the lord of the celestials when he will beg the ear-rings.

sa: पार्थिवानामधर्मत्वात् प्रजानामभवः सदा। स एष राजा जनकः प्रजा धर्मेण पश्यति॥
en: In consequence of the criminality of the rulers of the earth, the subjects undergo continuous harms. But Janaka is such a monarch, that he looks upon his subjects with virtuous eyes.

sa: चत्वारि यस्य द्वाराणि सुगुप्तान्यमरोत्तमाः। उपस्थमुदरं हस्तौ वाक चतुर्थी स धर्मवित्॥
en: You foremost of immortals, that person is said to be conversant with virtue whose four doors, viz., the organ of generation, the stoinach, the two arms, and speech, are well governed.

sa: तस्मात् संश्रावयामि त्वां विजयं जयतां वर। संस्तूयमाना वर्धन्ते महात्मानो युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Therefore do I make it listened to by you so that you may gain a victory, O best of victors. The great minded increase (in strength) by being glorified, O Yudhishthira.

sa: जगाम त्वरितो रामस्तीर्थं श्वेतानुलेपनः॥ निषेवितं सर्वसत्त्वैर्नाम्ना बदरपाचनम्। नानर्तुकवनोपेतं सदापुष्पफलं शुभम्॥
en: Abounding in various creatures, that Tirtha is known by the name of Badarapachana. There the fruits of every reason are always available and flowers and fruits of every kind always abundant."

sa: स राजा भूय एवाथ ज्ञात्वा तत्त्वमथागमत्। कन्येति पाञ्चालसुतां त्वरमाणो विनिर्ययौ।॥
en: That king (Hiranyavarman), thereupon once more ascertained the real fact, that the offspring of the king of the Panchalas was a daughter, and went forth (out of his city) without delay.

sa: अवेक्षस्व यथान्यायं पश्य देवासुरं यथा। राजन् किमन्यज्जातीनां वधाद् गृद्ध्यन्ति देवताः॥
en: Judge truly, O kihg, and mark the conduct of the gods and the Danavas. O king, do the gods ever seek anything else than the destruction of their kinsmen (the Asuras)?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यदप्यल्पतरं कर्म तदप्येकेन दुष्करम्। पुरुषेणासहायेन किमु राज्ञा पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Even the most insignificant act, O grandfather, cannot be accomplished by any man without co-operation. What then need be said of the king (who has to govern a kingdom)?

sa: सौते किं ते व्यवसितं कस्माद् यासि पराङ्मुखः। नैष वृष्णिप्रवीराणामाहवेधर्म उच्यते॥
en: Pradyumna said: O son of Suta, what have you done? Why do you go away, leaving the field of battle? This is not the usage of the Vrishni heroes in battle.

sa: विश्वस्तवदविश्वस्तस्तेषु वर्तेत सर्वदा। न हि दोषा गुणो वेति निरूप्यस्तेषु दृश्यते॥
en: Though one may mistrust them at heart, he should behave towards them as if he trusted them completely. Thinking of their nature, it seems that they have neither demerits nor merits.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणस्तं वीरं सिंहो मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥ मर्मस्वभ्यवधीत् क्रुद्धः पादाष्ठीलैः सुदारुणैः।
en: While saying so, Ashvatthaman, worked up with rage, began to strike the vital parts of his victim with his heels, and killed his foe like a lion killing an infuriate elephant.

sa: द्रोहाद् देवैरवाप्तानि दिवि स्थानानि सर्वशः। द्रोहात् किमन्यज्ज्ञातीनां गृद्ध्यन्ते येन देवताः॥
en: The gods, through civil war, have secured footing in the celestial region. When the very gods have won their prosperity through civil war, what fault can there be in such quarrels?

sa: कानीनस्त्वं मया जातः पूर्वजः कुक्षिणा धृतः। कुन्तिराजस्य भवने पार्थस्त्वमसि पुत्रक॥
en: You were begotten on me when I was an unmarried girl and you were the first held in my womb; you were born in the palace of Kuntiraja, my dear son.

sa: तस्य मेऽद्य स्थितस्येह स्वधर्मे नियतात्मनः। अनागसं प्रजानां च प्रमादादिव जल्पथ॥
en: I adhere to the practices of my order with a steadily soul. I never injure any of my subjects. In bringing this charge against me, it appears you speck in error.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच अनेन निश्चयेनाहं साध्वि सम्प्राप्तवानिह। प्रतीक्षन्नागमं देवि वत्स्याप्यस्मिन् महावने॥
en: The Brahmana said O chaste lady, I have come here with the object of seeing your husband. O reverend dame, I shall live in the adjacent forest, waiting for his return.

sa: तत्र भूतान्यनेकानि रक्षतेऽस्य प्रसङ्गतः। तं दिधक्षुर्न शक्नोमि दग्धुं शक्रस्य तेजसा॥
en: Many other creatures are also protected by him (in this forest) for the sake of Takshaka. Although I am ever desirous of consuming it, I cannot do it for Indra's prowess.
